paragraphs: He is mentioned in Taanit 26b, challenging the words of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi; Rabbi Yitzchak resolves his difficulty.[^1]

notes.text: The two whole Davidson Taanit 26b paragraphs give Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s statement followed by Hoshaya bar Zavda’s objection and Rabbi Yitzchak’s answer. The corresponding full local titles and direction are supported, without binding the alternative attribution in that paragraph to a single authority or importing the surrounding legal argument.
